description: This PHP class extends a basic display field class to include aggregation functionality for report display, specifying how certain data fields should be aggregated (e.g., minimum) for reporting purposes within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: GenericBasicDisplayFieldWithAggregate
classes.description: A specialized display field class supporting aggregation functions like MIN, MAX, etc., for reporting in OrangeHRM, extending the basic display field capabilities.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets the display field properties based on a display field entity, including setting the entity alias, the field, and the aggregation type.

methods.name: getAggregate
methods.description: Returns the aggregation function configured for this display field, such as 'MIN'.

methods.name: setAggregate
methods.description: Sets the aggregation function for this display field, e.g., 'MIN', 'MAX'.

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Constructs and returns the SQL select part string combining the aggregate function with the entity alias and field.
